title: Motivated-Reasoning Detection from Aggregate Behavior, No Internals Required

original_idea.body: Black-box aggregate detector of motivated reasoning via matched question pairs.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: black-box detector for a concrete honesty failure (undisclosed bias) is defensibly useful for monitoring deployed models.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Guided: matched-pair construction and aggregate statistics, clear methodology for novice+mentor.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused first deliverable (matched pairs, aggregate shift detector); some effort in dataset construction.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: replaces internal-access activation probing with a black-box method, weak lab incentive.

low_compute.reasoning: Pure inference over prompt pairs; CPU/free-tier or single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Behavioral aggregate detector for motivated reasoning may be open vs internals-based methods.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Aggregate behavioral detection angle may be open vs activation-probing.
